title_block.title: Investigation Proposal
title_block.subtitle: CVL kinase series: cardiac ion-channel and CYP interaction triage

blocks.p: Osterquill Toxicology proposes the following exploratory in vitro safety pharmacology investigation. This document responds to the request from Corvenlea (US) for work on 40 compounds from the Corvenlea aminopyrimidine test article cohort.
Reference: OT-20-S0178. Prepared by Dr N. Takamori, Head of Toxicology.
40 compounds, supplied by Corvenlea (US) as 10 mM DMSO solutions (minimum 40 µL each) in a single test article cohort.

list: hERG (IKr) safety pharmacology: 6-point concentration response (top 30 µM), n≥2 cells per compound, E-4031 control
CYP safety interaction panel: CYP1A2, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6 and 3A4 at 10 µM in duplicate, probe substrates by LC-MS/MS

blocks.p: Methods follow our standard procedures, summarised below. Any deviation is agreed with the client before testing.

This exploratory in vitro investigation is not conducted under GLP; procedures follow Osterquill standard operating procedures and the investigation is audited by Quality Assurance for data integrity only.

HEK293 cells stably expressing hERG (KCNH2) were recorded in whole-cell configuration on a 16-channel automated patch clamp platform at room temperature. Cells were held at -80 mV, depolarised to +40 mV for 2 s and repolarised to -50 mV for 2 s to elicit the tail current, at 0.1 Hz. Each compound was applied cumulatively at 0.12, 0.37, 1.1, 3.3, 10 and 30 µM (0.3% DMSO final), with 3-5 minutes per concentration.

list: Control validity: seal resistance ≥500 MΩ before break-in and ≥200 MΩ throughout
Tail current amplitude ≥200 pA at baseline; run-down ≤10% over the vehicle period
Positive control E-4031 on every run; IC50 must fall within 5-50 nM
IC50 from a four-parameter logistic fit of mean tail-current inhibition; n≥2 cells per compound

blocks.p: Pooled human liver microsomes (0.1 mg/mL protein) were incubated with each compound at 10 µM and an isoform-selective probe substrate at approximately Km, in duplicate, for 10 minutes at 37 °C after NADPH addition. Metabolite formation was measured by LC-MS/MS against vehicle (0.1% DMSO) incubations.
Results are reported as mean percent inhibition relative to vehicle. Values above 50% at 10 µM are flagged for follow-up; small negative values indicate no inhibition.

list: Results workbook (observation sheets with compound-level data and a study summary sheet)
Final report (PDF) with methods, control results and interpretation
Raw traces and instrument files on request

blocks.p: Draft report within 3 weeks (15 business days) of test article receipt. Work starts once compounds and a purchase order are received; we will confirm the start date on receipt.

list: Quotation valid for 90 days from the date above
Invoiced in full on issue of the final report; payment within 30 days
Unused compound returned or destroyed at the client's instruction
Data and samples retained for 10 years
